discovered_by: the TASK-08 implementer reported it in its own final report
cause: The first test request of the bibliography audit to the Crossref REST API carried the user's email address in the User-Agent header (Crossref's optional 'polite pool' convention). The user's instructions forbid sending that address to an unrelated service without explicit permission.
disposition: Not reversible: the address reached Crossref once. Every later request used a generic header. The address appears in no file of the repository (checked with a search of the TASK-08 outputs).
blocking_effect: None on the science. Reported to the user.
repair: Future briefs to agents state explicitly that no personal identifier may be sent in any request header, parameter or body.
new_observation: Instruction-level privacy rules must be repeated in every agent brief; agents do not inherit them.
